mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% and acceleration in employment growth above 100 thousand persons per month signals an overheating labor market that triggers central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth exceeding 6.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to central bank tightening and economic uncertainty, over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 6.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (indicating a strengthening labor market) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as it reflects robust economic growth and corporate earnings expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in industrial production growth (3-month annualized rate below 0.5%) signals a weakening real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO growth < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (3-month annualized growth below -0.5%) and weak retail sales growth (3-month annualized growth below 0.5%) signals a deteriorating consumer demand environment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions (GDP growth above 2.0% but declining from the previous quarter), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to impending monetary tightening, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
